changelog:
v3.6.4 — New Branded Icon + Live TV Cursor Fix

Branding
• New Ooustream IPTV app banner and launcher icon — easier to spot on the Fire TV home screen alongside your other apps. Same logo across the home banner, launcher list, and adaptive icon.

Live TV
• Fixed: tapping a channel in Live TV sometimes made the gold focus cursor disappear. You had to D-pad back to the same channel just to go fullscreen. Now the cursor stays put — first OK starts preview, second OK on the same channel goes fullscreen.
